routing_constraints: USB-C duplicate D+/D- pads interleave; their join must be designed explicitly, not modeled as one endpoint per net
U2 flow-through paired routing must include both pin1/6 and pin3/4, not an arbitrary tee
Front U2 is left of connector and MCU right/upper: surface move adds lateral detour; compare with existing short backside protection route
Do not assume 12Mbps makes impedance/reference requirements unnecessary
reference_status: Official current AN4879 discovered; search metadata alone is not sufficient to approve exact layout limits
